description: Cloud operations on private infrastructure: capacity planned before it runs out, routine work automated, a self-service catalog with guardrails, costs shown per team, and security posture checked against a baseline.

types.capacity_plan: Capacity forecasts per cluster, with the date each runs out
types.anomaly_alert: Alerts on behaviour that departs from what is normal
types.runbook: Automated runbooks for routine and corrective tasks
types.catalog_item: Self-service catalog items with approvals and quotas
types.cost_model: Cost allocated to teams or projects, shown back or charged back
types.posture_baseline: Security and compliance baselines checked continuously
